FIDELITY, sentence by sentence against the source. The draft kept every base-line item and every tester fix I traced with git log -S (ece78b2: card-true wants, help or hold, one beat, stop point, 1-2 lists, small jokes none when sincere, the move landing first as an act; 6993aed: secrets kept and the plan-line paragraph fix; 570c222: questions get only an OOC answer with no header or ledger). Now 'Reasoning: N lines; go ends it.', matching Tags-on's '; go ends the thinking'. (2) 'all' on the length cap: the source caps the whole plan at one reply paragraph ('all shorter than'); the draft's 'under one reply paragraph' could be read per fragment. (3) 'each building on the last' (in the plan since 279bb31's 'a written line is settled and the next builds on it'): now 'settled and built on', the same length as the draft's 'settled once written'. (4) Fresh's noun: the draft's '1-2 new' had lost 'details'. Paid for by 'not reply sentences/drafts' -> 'no reply drafts' (Fragments already rules out sentences, and a reply sentence in the plan is a draft) and 'one' -> 'a' reply paragraph. Checked and approved as compression, with where each rule still lives: the four pointers (Main states the rules under those labels), card-true jokes and the flowing scene (G2's final gate), resting (card mood), acting (scope only), dashed (template, Tags-on head and cue), and each NPC's next act for each character's (ARIA's own term in Freaky and Bonds, the JB's and the Douyin CoT's; it also keeps {{user}}'s act out of Move). G2 dropped 'plan line' from the gate, so 'never a paragraph per plan line' now lives only here; it stays. SIZE. The regex anchors only 'opens the reply, then ', and the echo clean-up gives identical results. No rationale aimed at the model; the plan lines are fragments joined by semicolons. RENDERING. 6,144 renders (CC plain, twin and TC, Tags on and off, every on/off mix of the ten spliced variables with real values) show no doubled space, no space before punctuation, no blank line, no line ending on a separator and no leftover macro, and the head's count always equals the printed lines. Ledger lines.' after 'Nothing above go enters the reply.', so an echoed TC template leaves the 'For a message written as {{user}} ...' sentence and the 'Every response starts with' line behind; the fix belongs to ARIA's regex scripts, which Chibi copies unchanged.
